meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求它分析近期工作,它会读取本机 screenpipe 记录的屏幕活动,找出反复出现的工作模式,和已有的技能比对,然后起草新的技能文件(或把几个现有技能串成组合流程),放进提案文件夹供你审核。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求分析最近的工作并提议新技能时触发,例如“分析我最近4小时/一天/一周的工作并提出新技能”“看看我没覆盖到的部分”“根据我的近期工作流草拟技能”。需要本机 screenpipe 服务在 3030 端口运行。

say.text: 分析我最近一天的工作,提议新技能。
say.note: 读取本机屏幕记录,聚类后生成提案文件夹。

say.text: 看看我这两周重复做的事里,哪些还没有现成技能。
say.note: 会对照已有的 135 个技能逐个匹配。

say.text: 把我最近的文献调研流程写成一个新技能草案。
say.note: 匹配不到现有技能时,会起草完整 SKILL.md。

howto.what_en: After install, on request, it reads local screenpipe screen history, detects repeated workflows, matches them against existing skills, and drafts new skill files (or chained recipes) into a proposal folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered on explicit user requests to analyze recent work and propose skills (e.g., "analyze my last 4 hours/day/week", "what's not covered?"). Requires local screenpipe on port 3030.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and propose new skills.
say_en.note: Reads local screen history and writes proposals to a folder.

say_en.text: What I've repeated this week isn't covered by existing skills?
say_en.note: Matches clusters against the 135 existing skills.

say_en.text: Draft a new skill from my recent literature-review workflow.
say_en.note: If no existing skill matches, drafts a full SKILL.md.
